title: How Much Does a YouTube Thumbnail Cost on Fiverr?
h1: How much does a YouTube thumbnail cost on Fiverr?
description: What thumbnail designers on Fiverr charge, based on the sellers we checked, what changes the price, and how to get good thumbnails without overpaying.
intro: Thumbnails are one of the cheapest and most useful things a YouTube channel can outsource. Prices on Fiverr are low compared with most design work, but packages differ in what they include. This article shows the starting prices of the thumbnail designers we feature, explains what moves the price up or down, and gives a short checklist for ordering.

faq.q: Why are thumbnails so cheap on Fiverr?
faq.a: A thumbnail is a small, repeatable job, and many designers work from templates and bulk workflows. The low starting price usually covers one simple design.

faq.q: Should I buy one thumbnail or a bulk package?
faq.a: Start with one to test the style. If it works, a bulk or monthly arrangement with the same designer keeps your channel consistent.

faq.q: Do I get the source file?
faq.a: Not always. Many basic packages deliver only the image. Ask for the PSD or other source file if you want to edit text yourself later.

faq.q: Can I use my own photos?
faq.a: Yes, and you should. Send a clear, well-lit photo of your face or product in high resolution. Designers can't fix a blurry photo.
Many thumbnail designers deliver within one or two days. Faster delivery is often an extra.
